errors.text_span: линейни диаграми
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the charts as 'линейни диаграми' (line charts) when they are in fact pie charts.

errors.text_span: Всеки домейн е разделен на четири сектора.
errors.evidence: The description states that each chart has four sectors, but chart (a) clearly has six sectors.

errors.text_span: В химията (a) първият зелен сектор представлява 9% от общата маса, вторият кафяв сектор представлява 31%, третият зелен сектор представлява 15%, а последният тъмно синя сектор представлява 21%.
errors.evidence: The description of chart (a) incorrectly maps colors to percentages. For example, it states the 31% sector is brown when it is blue with diagonal lines, and the 9% sector is green when it is yellow with a weave pattern. It also misses two sectors entirely (the 17% and 7% slices).

errors.text_span: В математиката (b) първият жълт сектор представлява 27%, вторият розов сектор представлява 19%, третият кафяв сектор представлява 38% и последният тъмно синя сектор представлява 15%.
errors.evidence: The description of chart (b) incorrectly maps colors to percentages. For example, it states the 27% sector is yellow when it is reddish, and the 38% sector is brown when it is blue with diagonal lines.

The description fails to mention the labels for any of the sectors in either chart (e.g., 'the', 'this', 'for' in chart a; 'the', 'S', 'equilibrium' in chart b), which are provided in the legends. The prompt specifically asks to describe the label for each sector.

errors.text_span: отбелязано вътре в самия сектор
errors.evidence: The description states that the percentage values are labeled inside the sectors, but they are clearly located outside the sectors in the figure.

errors.text_span: които са жизненоважни за темата, представена на диаграмата
errors.evidence: The phrase 'which are vital for the topic presented in the diagram' is a subjective interpretation and violates the instruction to avoid interpretation and use neutral language.

errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token types associated with the word “reaction” in two distinct domains: chemistry and mathematics. The chart contains eight slices, representing eight different token types
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the two separate pie charts in the figure as a single chart with eight slices. The figure actually contains two charts, labeled (a) and (b), with 6 and 4 slices respectively.

errors.text_span: The slice labeled “this” is represented in light yellow and occupies approximately 7%
errors.evidence: The slice labeled "this" is in chart (a), has a value of 21%, and is light blue with horizontal lines. The description incorrectly assigns the value (7%, which belongs to "in") and color/pattern.

errors.text_span: the slice labeled “the” is represented in light orange and approximately 15%
errors.evidence: The slice labeled "the" is present in both charts (31% and 38%) and is represented by a blue diagonal line pattern. The description assigns an incorrect color and value.

errors.text_span: the slice labeled “chemical” is represented in light green and occupies 31%
errors.evidence: The slice for "chemical" in chart (a) has a value of 15%, not 31%. 31% corresponds to the slice for "the" in the same chart.

errors.text_span: the slice labeled “constant” is represented in dark blue and occupies 38%
errors.evidence: The slice in chart (b) is labeled "consatant", has a value of 15%, and is gray with a dot pattern. The description incorrectly states the label, color, and value.

errors.text_span: the slice labeled “$” is represented in dark purple and approximately 27%
errors.evidence: The slice labeled "S" (which can be misread as "$") in chart (b) is red with a cross pattern, not dark purple.

errors.text_span: the slice labeled “reaction” is represented in light blue and occupies 21%
errors.evidence: There is no slice labeled "reaction" in either pie chart. The word "reaction" is from the paper caption, not from the chart itself.

errors.text_span: and the slice labeled “III” is represented in light brown and occupies 17%
errors.evidence: There is no slice labeled "III" in either pie chart.

errors.text_span: Percentage labels are displayed within each slice
errors.evidence: The percentage labels are positioned outside of the pie slices, adjacent to them.

errors.text_span: There is no legend provided
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Both pie charts have a legend at the top that maps patterns to labels.

The description fails to explain the structure of the figure, which consists of two distinct sub-panels, (a) for chemistry and (b) for mathematics. This is essential for understanding what the figure represents.
The description fails to mention the distinct patterns (e.g., diagonal lines, horizontal lines, crosshatch, dots) used to differentiate the slices, instead vaguely mentioning colors.

errors.text_span: Es werden insgesamt vier Segmente dargestellt
errors.evidence: The figure contains two pie charts. Chart (a) has six segments and chart (b) has four segments, for a total of ten segments, not four.

errors.text_span: wobei die chemische Domäne einen Anteil von 31 % ausmacht
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the 'chemische Domäne' (chemistry domain) as a segment of the chart. In fact, 'Chemie' refers to the entirety of chart (a), and the 31% segment within that chart corresponds to the token 'the'.

errors.text_span: die mathematische Domäne macht 27 % aus
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the 'mathematische Domäne' (mathematics domain) as a segment of the chart. 'Mathematik' refers to the entirety of chart (b), and the 27% segment within that chart corresponds to the token 'S'.

errors.text_span: mit einem gelblichen Bereich, der etwa 15 % darstellt
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence describes the mathematics chart. The yellowish area in the mathematics chart (b) corresponds to 'equilibrium' and has a value of 19%, not 15%. The 15% segment is gray.

errors.text_span: ein blauer Bereich, der etwa 15 % darstellt
errors.evidence: Neither chart contains a blue segment that represents 15%. In chart (a), the blue segments are 31% and 21%. In chart (b), the blue segment is 38%.

errors.text_span: ein grüner Bereich, der etwa 17 % darstellt und ein blauer Bereich, der 21 % ausmacht
errors.evidence: These segments (17% green and 21% blue) are from chart (a), but they are listed illogically as part of the description of the 'mathematische Domäne' (chart b), making the entire sentence structure confusing and nonsensical.

errors.text_span: Die Segmente scheinen in einer absteigenden Reihenfolge nach Größe angeordnet zu sein.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. In both charts, the segments are not arranged in descending order of size when viewed clockwise or counter-clockwise from any starting point.

The description fails to mention the majority of the segment labels (e.g., 'the', 'this', 'for', 'in', 'S', 'equilibrium', 'consatant') and their corresponding percentages, which was a key requirement of the prompt.
